title: pi-codex-minimal-tools model catalog overrides
description: Per-model Codex protocol and tool capability profiles. User entries override bundled entries by exact provider/model id.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

models.description: Exact per-model profiles. Duplicate ids in one user file are rejected.

id.description: Exact provider/model id, for example openai/gpt-5.5.

extends.description: Optional parent profile. The parent is deep-merged first; arrays are replaced.

enabled.description: Whether this profile can activate extension behavior.

providerShim.description: Use this extension's Codex Responses serializer/parser. The Pi model must use api openai-responses or openai-codex-responses.

mode.description: Standard Responses or the internal Codex Responses Lite envelope.

systemPromptPlacement.description: Standard-mode prompt placement. Lite always uses a developer message.

websocketPrewarm.description: Send a best-effort generate:false prewarm request for WebSocket transports.

parallelCalls.description: Whether the request permits parallel tool calls. Lite always forces false.

applyPatch.description: Disable apply_patch, expose a JSON function tool, or use the Codex freeform custom tool.

webSearch.description: Disable web search or choose hosted Responses search versus standalone Codex web.run.

implementation.description: hosted is server-executed; standalone calls the Codex alpha/search endpoint.

contentTypes.description: Search modalities advertised or accepted by this model.

imageGeneration.description: Disable image generation, use hosted Responses image_generation, or use standalone Codex Images endpoints.

viewImage.description: Expose the local view_image tool when the Pi model accepts image input.

compaction.description: Pi summary compaction, Codex remote compaction v2, or the legacy /responses/compact endpoint.

fast.description: Disable Fast mode for this model or configure its service tier and optional usage-cost multiplier.

serviceTier.description: Responses service_tier value sent when the global Fast toggle is enabled.

costMultiplier.description: Optional multiplier applied to Pi's reported request cost for this tier.
